answer: Commit a hash of the receipt before grading and reveal it only after the panel locks its score, so an operator cannot tailor an answer to reviewers it can already see. Duplicate reveals forfeit the bond, and a quorum entirely inside one subnetwork is not counted, which closes the cheapest failure mode, a farm grading its own work. A forger must now hold distinct commitments across unrelated networks and open each one honestly at the right moment, paying a bond each time a marble is dropped and losing the whole ember when one receipt is revealed twice.
